subject: Remove overhead.hashtable.slot-to-keys from memory-stats reply_schema (#12784)
reason: The change only removes a stale entry (overhead.hashtable.slot-to-keys) from memory-stats.json's reply_schema and a blank line in object.c. No code in the checkout emits that field (grep for slot-to-keys finds nothing in src/), so the MEMORY STATS reply is byte-identical on both builds; reply schemas are doc/test metadata not compiled into normal builds. This is a documentation/schema cleanup with no behavior change, so no scenario can observe a difference.
